name: Workstream A: Complete GraphQL API Independence
description: Remove all direct PracteraCore (CakePHP) dependencies from practera-graphql-api. Complete the GraphQL implementation so app-v2 no longer calls the PHP API.

name: Workstream B1: Topics and Progress GraphQL Operations
description: Implement new GraphQL operations for Topics and Progress tracking to replace CakePHP-served data.

name: Workstream B2: Events GraphQL Operations (bookEvent, cancelEvent)
description: Add bookEvent and cancelEvent mutations to GraphQL API, removing dependency on CakePHP events API.

name: Workstream B3: Notifications GraphQL (updateTodoItem)
description: Implement updateTodoItem mutation and notification management in GraphQL to eliminate CakePHP notification API calls.

name: Workstream B4: Assessment Extras (resubmit, reviewRating)
description: Add resubmitAssessment and updateReviewRating operations to GraphQL, completing assessment feature parity.

name: Workstream B5: Auth Consolidation
description: Consolidate authentication flow so login-api is the single auth authority. Remove CakePHP auth endpoints from app-v2 service layer.

name: Workstream B6: Frontend Rewiring (app-v2 services)
description: Update all practera-app service layer calls to use GraphQL API exclusively. Remove all direct CakePHP API calls from app-v2.

name: Workstream C: Admin Frontend Modernization
description: Progressively replace CakePHP admin views with modern Next.js/React pages, starting with the most-used admin domains.

name: Workstream D: CakePHP API Retirement
description: Systematically retire CakePHP API endpoints as each is replaced by GraphQL equivalents. Full retirement target by end of 2026.

name: Global Login Refactor — LTI, Passkey, Magic Link GA
description: Bring the login-api and login-app refactor to general availability. Complete passkey (WebAuthn) support, stack switching, and LTI MFA flows.

name: GraphQL API: File Upload via TUS
description: Integrate TUS resumable upload protocol into the GraphQL API layer to replace Filestack dependency.

name: GraphQL API: Real-time subscriptions (Soketi/Pusher)
description: Add GraphQL subscriptions for live notifications, chat, and activity updates using Soketi.

name: Reporting System Phase 2 — New Report Engine
description: Launch the new reporting system with configurable reports, data exports, and experience-level analytics.

name: Project Brief Generator V1
description: Launch the AI-powered project brief generator as a production feature for coordinators and industry partners.

name: AI Coach — Team Chat GA
description: Launch AI Coach in team chat channels for learner support, question answering, and progress nudges.

name: Security Audit & Penetration Testing
description: Full platform security audit with penetration testing. Remediate identified vulnerabilities.

name: Product Catalog — Industry Project Sourcing
description: Launch the Product Catalog feature enabling coordinators to browse and allocate industry projects to programs.

name: Skills Tracking & Badging System
description: Implement skills tracking in the learner app with competency mapping, skill progress, and digital badging.

name: Mentor & Industry Partner Portal
description: Dedicated portal experience for mentors and industry partners with project visibility, learner progress, and feedback workflows.
